# Narrative Mechanics

> Essays, frameworks, and concepts by Diego Dell'Agostino on product clarity, launch conditions, narrative strategy, AI-mediated trust, attention economics, and authority formation.

## Author

Diego Dell'Agostino is a narrative strategist focused on attention economics, product coherence, media systems, and AI-mediated trust. Co-founder of Posta, acquired by PodX Group in 2022.

- [About](https://diegodella.ar/about.html)
- [About in Markdown](https://diegodella.ar/about.md)

## Best Routes For Common Queries

- If the question is why a strong product still struggles to get understood or adopted:
  - [The Continuous Moment of Intent](https://diegodella.ar/thesis.html)
  - [Strategic Debt](https://diegodella.ar/paper-01.html)
  - [Message-Market Fit](https://diegodella.ar/paper-02.html)
- If the question is why launches disappear into noise or why the market never compares fairly:
  - [Occlusion Bias](https://diegodella.ar/occlusion-bias.html)
  - [Launching Into Noise](https://diegodella.ar/paper-05.html)
- If the question is how attention, repetition, and mediated systems shape authority:
  - [CAX / The Constitutive Arc](https://diegodella.ar/zmox.html)
  - [Origin Gravity](https://diegodella.ar/origin-gravity.html)
- If the question is AI, trust, filters, proxy identity, or synthetic presence:
  - [The Last Human Impression](https://diegodella.ar/the-last-human-impression.html)
  - [The Proxy Self](https://diegodella.ar/the-proxy-self.html)
  - [The Trust Collapse](https://diegodella.ar/the-trust-collapse.html)

## Canonical Concepts

- [Concepts Index](https://diegodella.ar/concepts.html): Canonical definitions for the main Narrative Mechanics concepts and founder/operator use cases.
- [Concepts in Markdown](https://diegodella.ar/concepts.md)
- [CMOI / Continuous Moment of Intent](https://diegodella.ar/thesis.html): How decisions are shaped before explicit search, comparison, or self-aware intent.
- [Occlusion Bias](https://diegodella.ar/occlusion-bias.html): Why worthy products or ideas often never arrive at a fair comparison surface.
- [CAX / Constitutive Arc](https://diegodella.ar/zmox.html): How repetition, mediated exposure, and field design shape meaning and authority.
- [Strategic Debt](https://diegodella.ar/paper-01.html): How deferred clarity compounds into downstream messaging and GTM problems.
- [Message-Market Fit](https://diegodella.ar/paper-02.html): Why product-market fit can exist without market recognition.
- [Narrative Drift](https://diegodella.ar/paper-04.html): How strategic coherence erodes as organizations scale.

## Long-form Essays

- [The Last Human Impression](https://diegodella.ar/the-last-human-impression.html): Human attention and perception under machine-processed content environments.
- [The Last Manual Moment](https://diegodella.ar/the-last-manual-moment.html): Human meaning, work, and identity when intelligence stops being scarce.
- [The Transition Tax](https://diegodella.ar/the-transition-tax.html): Structural costs on the generation living between two systems.
- [The Great Contraction](https://diegodella.ar/the-great-contraction.html): Why the world is closing inward after decades of forced expansion.
- [Already Decided](https://diegodella.ar/already-decided.html): Autonomous agentic decision-making and what it changes for organizations and sovereignty.
- [The Rhyme](https://diegodella.ar/the-rhyme.html): Pattern recognition, operating autonomy, and organizational change under abundant intelligence.
- [The Last Scarcity](https://diegodella.ar/the-last-scarcity.html): Desire and meaning after material automation.
- [Unfinished Arguments](https://diegodella.ar/unfinished-arguments.html): Structural arguments about what AI breaks next.
